```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'crates/**'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'AGENTS.md'
      - '.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'crates/**'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'AGENTS.md'
      - '.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  generate-ai-context:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: rustfmt, clippy
          cache: true

      - name: Setup Node.js and pnpm
        uses: oxc-project/setup-node@8958a8e040102244b619c4a94fccb657a44b1c21

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cargo fetch
          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Generate Rust Documentation
        run: |
          mkdir -p ai-context/docs
          cargo doc --no-deps --output-format json 2>/dev/null || cargo doc --no-deps
          # If json output is not supported or fails, fallback to html structure analysis
          if [ ! -f target/doc/oxc_resolver.json ]; then
            echo "Generating HTML docs for structure analysis..."
            cargo doc --no-deps
          fi

      - name: Extract TypeScript Definitions
        run: |
          mkdir -p ai-context/types
          # Attempt to build the node bindings to generate .d.ts files if they are generated at build time
          pnpm build 2>/dev/null || true
          # Copy existing .d.ts files if present
          find . -name "*.d.ts" -not -path "./node_modules/*" -exec cp {} ai-context/types/ \; 2>/dev/null || true
          # If no .d.ts found, create a placeholder with package.json exports info
          if [ -z "$(ls -A ai-context/types)" ]; then
            echo "// TypeScript definitions extracted from package.json exports" > ai-context/types/definitions.md
            cat package.json | jq '.exports' >> ai-context/types/definitions.md 2>/dev/null || echo "No exports found in package.json" >> ai-context/types/definitions.md
          fi

      - name: Analyze Code Structure
        run: |
          mkdir -p ai-context/structure
          echo "# Source File Organization" > ai-context/structure/overview.md
          echo "" >> ai-context/structure/overview.md
          
          echo "## Rust Crates" >> ai-context/structure/overview.md
          for crate in crates/*/; do
            if [ -d "$crate" ]; then
              crate_name=$(basename "$crate")
              echo "- **$crate_name**:" >> ai-context/structure/overview.md
              # Extract description from Cargo.toml if available
              desc=$(grep -A 1 '^\[package\]' "$crate/Cargo.toml" | grep description | cut -d'"' -f2)
              if [ -n "$desc" ]; then
                echo "  - Description: $desc" >> ai-context/structure/overview.md
              fi
              # List main source files
              echo "  - Key files:" >> ai-context/structure/overview.md
              find "$crate/src" -name "*.rs" -type f | head -10 | while read file; do
                echo "    - $(basename $file)" >> ai-context/structure/overview.md
              done
            fi
          done

          echo "" >> ai-context/structure/overview.md
          echo "## Node.js/TypeScript Sources" >> ai-context/structure/overview.md
          find src -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.js" | head -20 | while read file; do
            echo "- $file" >> ai-context/structure/overview.md
          done

      - name: Extract Configuration
        run: |
          mkdir -p ai-context/config
          echo "# Configuration Summary" > ai-context/config/summary.md
          echo "" >> ai-context/config/summary.md
          
          echo "## Cargo.toml (Root)" >> ai-context/config/summary.md
          echo '```toml' >> ai-context/config/summary.md
          cat Cargo.toml >> ai-context/config/summary.md
          echo '```' >> ai-context/config/summary.md
          echo "" >> ai-context/config/summary.md
          
          echo "## package.json" >> ai-context/config/summary.md
          echo '```json' >> ai-context/config/summary.md
          cat package.json >> ai-context/config/summary.md
          echo '```' >> ai-context/config/summary.md

      - name: Map Test Architecture
        run: |
          mkdir -p ai-context/tests
          echo "# Test Architecture" > ai-context/tests/overview.md
          echo "" >> ai-context/tests/overview.md
          
          echo "## Rust Tests" >> ai-context/tests/overview.md
          find crates -name "*test*.rs" -o -name "tests" -type d | while read file; do
            echo "- $file" >> ai-context/tests/overview.md
          done
          
          echo "" >> ai-context/tests/overview.md
          echo "## Node.js Tests" >> ai-context/tests/overview.md
          find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -name "*.test.ts" -print -o -name "*.spec.ts" -print | while read file; do
            echo "- $file" >> ai-context/tests/overview.md
          done

      - name: Validate AGENTS.md
        run: |
          if [ ! -f AGENTS.md ]; then
            echo "::error::AGENTS.md not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          required_sections=("Project Overview" "Development Workflow" "Code Conventions" "Testing Strategy" "Common Patterns" "Performance Considerations" "Debugging")
          for section in "${required_sections[@]}"; do
            if ! grep -q "$section" AGENTS.md; then
              echo "::warning::AGENTS.md is missing required section: $section"
            fi
          done
          
          # Check for code examples
          if ! grep -q '```' AGENTS.md; then
            echo "::warning::AGENTS.md should contain code examples"
          fi

      - name: Upload AI Context Bundle
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ai-context-bundle
          path: ai-context/
          retention-days: 5
```
